content.json:
User Access & Role Review Dashboard

Automated view of current PIM assignments and Azure subscription role bindings.

content.query:
GroupMembership_CL
| where TimeGenerated == toscalar(
    GroupMembership_CL
    | summarize max(TimeGenerated)
)
| extend records_json = parse_json(body_s)
| mv-expand member = records_json
| project 
    GroupName = tostring(member.GroupName),
    UserPrincipalName = tostring(member.UserPrincipalName),
    DisplayName = tostring(member.DisplayName)
| where isnotempty(DisplayName)
| sort by GroupName asc
content.title: Exclusion Group Memberships

content.query:
let LatestTime = toscalar(PIMAssignments_CL | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
PIMAssignments_CL
| where TimeGenerated between (LatestTime - 5s .. LatestTime)
| extend roleName = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists("roleName_s",""), column_ifexists("roleName","")))
| extend name     = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists("name_s",""), column_ifexists("userOrServiceName_s",""), column_ifexists("userOrServiceName","")))
| extend rtype    = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists("type_s",""), column_ifexists("type","")))
| extend principalId = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists("principalId_g",""), column_ifexists("principalId","")))
| project roleName, name, rtype, principalId
| order by roleName asc, name asc
content.title: PIM Role Assignments

content.query:
let LatestTime = toscalar(SubscriptionRoleReview_CL | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
SubscriptionRoleReview_CL
| where TimeGenerated between (LatestTime - 5s .. LatestTime)
| extend userOrServiceName = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists("userOrServiceName_s",""), column_ifexists("userOrServiceName","")))
| extend roleName         = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists("roleName_s",""),         column_ifexists("roleName","")))
| extend principalId      = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists("principalId_g",""),      column_ifexists("principalId","")))
| project TimeGenerated, userOrServiceName, roleName
| order by roleName asc, userOrServiceName asc
content.title: Current Subscription Role Assignments

content.query:
InactiveUserAccounts_CL
| extend users = parse_json(body_s)
| mv-expand users
| extend
    displayName       = tostring(users.displayName),
    userPrincipalName = tostring(users.userPrincipalName),
    accountEnabled    = tobool(users.accountEnabled),
    lastSignInDateTime = todatetime(users.lastSignInDateTime)
| where lastSignInDateTime < ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(lastSignInDateTime, displayName, accountEnabled) by userPrincipalName
| project displayName, userPrincipalName, accountEnabled, lastSignInDateTime
| order by lastSignInDateTime desc
| where displayName !contains "Inactive"
content.title: Inactive User Accounts (30+ Days)

content.query:
InactiveEntraDevices_CL
| where deviceInfo_lastSignIn_t < ago(30d)
//| where isnotempty(deviceInfo_ownerUPN_s)
| summarize arg_max(deviceInfo_lastSignIn_t, deviceInfo_deviceName_s, deviceInfo_ownerUPN_s, deviceInfo_operatingSystem_s) by deviceInfo_deviceId_g
| project deviceInfo_deviceName_s, deviceInfo_lastSignIn_t, deviceInfo_ownerUPN_s, deviceInfo_operatingSystem_s
| where deviceInfo_operatingSystem_s == "Windows"
content.title: Inactive Devices 30+ days
